new_libraries.name: ESP32 BLE Keyboard
new_libraries.author: Gaurav Sharma
new_libraries.sentence: Bluetooth HID Keyboard library for ESP32 boards.
new_libraries.paragraph: Allows ESP32 boards to emulate a Bluetooth Low Energy HID keyboard with support for text, key presses, and multimedia keys.

new_libraries.name: ESPNowUtilities
new_libraries.author: Christoph Streit <christoph.streit@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Paired, single-peer ESP-NOW links between two ESP32 boards.
new_libraries.paragraph: Wraps ESP-NOW in a connection class that handles discovery and pairing, tracks one peer with a liveness timeout, and carries application messages of your own definition. The wire format of those messages is yours; the library only routes them and confirms they came from the paired peer.

library.name: UpdateOTW
library.author: Ítalo Coelho
library.sentence: Peer-to-peer firmware update over the wire (Modbus RTU / RS485).
library.paragraph: Stream a firmware image from a Modbus RTU master to a slave over a half-duplex RS485 bus, and the slave reboots into it. Two register-array state machines (UpdateOTW_Master sender, UpdateOTW_Slave receiver) — your code keeps doing the Modbus, the library only reads/writes a small register window. Non-blocking (one frame per tick), so the device keeps running while it updates, with deferred apply. Per-chunk CRC16 plus full-image CRC32, automatic retry with patient back-off, and free rollback via the ESP32 Update library. No external dependencies.
